options.content:
- **Use case:** AI code tracking, repo/PR attribution, and conversation insights from Cursor Enterprise Analytics (`/analytics/ai-code/*`, Conversation Insights).
- **Data source:** Cursor plugin — requires `key_tier=enterprise` on the connection. Commit-detail cost panels also require `hasAiCodeCommitDetails`.
- **Related:** [Cursor Usage & Cost](/d/cursor_usage-pg) for billing and adoption; [Cursor BugBot Review Analytics](/d/cursor_bugbot-pg) for automated PR reviews.

panels.description: Share of committed lines attributed to TAB, Composer, and non-AI coding from GET /analytics/ai-code/commits (Enterprise API). Requires an enterprise key.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(ts AS DATE) AS time, metric, SUM(value) AS value FROM (SELECT COALESCE(commit_ts, ingested_at, created_at) AS ts, 'TAB' AS metric, tab_lines_added AS value FROM _tool_cursor_ai_code_commits WHERE $__timeFilter(COALESCE(commit_ts, ingested_at, created_at)) AND ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(commit_ts, ingested_at, created_at), 'Composer', composer_lines_added FROM _tool_cursor_ai_code_commits WHERE $__timeFilter(COALESCE(commit_ts, ingested_at, created_at)) AND ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(commit_ts, ingested_at, created_at), 'Non-AI', COALESCE(non_ai_lines_added, GREATEST(total_lines_added - tab_lines_added - composer_lines_added, 0)) FROM _tool_cursor_ai_code_commits WHERE $__timeFilter(COALESCE(commit_ts, ingested_at, created_at)) AND ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}') AS src GROUP BY CAST(ts AS DATE), "metric" ORDER BY 1 NULLS FIRST

panels.title: Committed Lines by AI Source

panels.description: Distribution of commits by source channel (IDE, CLI, Cloud) from GET /analytics/ai-code/commits

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(commit_source, ''), 'unknown')) WHEN 'ide' THEN 'IDE' WHEN 'cli' THEN 'CLI' WHEN 'cloud' THEN 'Cloud' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS "Source", COUNT(*) AS "Commits" FROM _tool_cursor_ai_code_commits WHERE $__timeFilter(COALESCE(commit_ts, ingested_at, created_at)) AND ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Commits by Source

panels.description: Users ranked by TAB + Composer lines committed in the selected period

targets.rawSql: SELECT user_email AS "User", SUM(tab_lines_added + composer_lines_added) AS "AI Lines Added", SUM(total_lines_added) AS "Total Lines Added", ROUND(CAST(SUM(tab_lines_added + composer_lines_added) * 100.0 AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(total_lines_added), 0), 0), 1) AS "AI Share %" FROM _tool_cursor_ai_code_commits WHERE $__timeFilter(COALESCE(commit_ts, ingested_at, created_at)) AND ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' GROUP BY "user_email" HAVING SUM(total_lines_added) > 0 ORDER BY SUM(tab_lines_added + composer_lines_added) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 15

panels.title: Top Contributors by AI-Assisted Lines

panels.description: Repositories ranked by AI-assisted committed lines and attributed AI usage cost in the selected period. Cost requires Tier 4 commit-detail data and is deduplicated per conversation.

targets.rawSql: WITH conv_cost AS (SELECT conversation_id, SUM(charged_cents) AS cost_cents FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events WHERE ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY conversation_id), repo_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(repo_name, ''), 'Unknown') AS repo_name, COUNT(*) AS commit_count, SUM(total_lines_added) AS line_count, ROUND(CAST(SUM(tab_lines_added + composer_lines_added) * 100.0 AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(total_lines_added), 0), 0), 1) AS ai_share_pct FROM _tool_cursor_ai_code_commits WHERE $__timeFilter(COALESCE(commit_ts, "ingested_at", created_at)) AND ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(repo_name, ''), 'Unknown')), repo_cost AS (SELECT rc.repo_name, COUNT(DISTINCT rc.conversation_id) AS conversations, SUM(cc.cost_cents) AS cost_cents FROM (SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(c.repo_name, ''), 'Unknown') AS repo_name, rann.conversation_id FROM _tool_cursor_ai_code_range_annotations AS rann JOIN _tool_cursor_ai_code_commits AS c ON c.commit_hash = rann.commit_hash AND c.connection_id = rann.connection_id AND c.scope_id = rann.scope_id WHERE ('${connection_id}' = '' OR rann.connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND rann.scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND rann.conversation_id <> '') AS rc JOIN conv_cost AS cc ON cc.conversation_id = rc.conversation_id GROUP BY rc.repo_name) SELECT COALESCE(rl.repo_name, rc.repo_name) AS "Repo", COALESCE(rl.commit_count, 0) AS "Commits", COALESCE(rl.line_count, 0) AS "Lines", rl.ai_share_pct AS "AI Share %", COALESCE(rc.conversations, 0) AS "Conversations", ROUND(CAST(CAST(COALESCE(rc.cost_cents, 0) AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(100, 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS "AI Cost (USD)" FROM repo_lines AS rl LEFT JOIN repo_cost AS rc ON rc.repo_name = rl.repo_name WHERE COALESCE(rl.line_count, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(rc.cost_cents, 0) > 0 UNION SELECT rc.repo_name, 0, 0, "NULL", rc.conversations, ROUND(CAST(CAST(rc.cost_cents AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(100, 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) FROM repo_cost AS rc LEFT JOIN repo_lines AS rl ON rl.repo_name = rc.repo_name WHERE rl.repo_name IS NULL ORDER BY "AI Cost (USD)" DESC NULLS LAST, "Lines" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 15

panels.title: Top Repos by AI Lines & Cost

panels.description: Pull requests with AI line attribution and attributed AI usage cost in the selected period. Requires GitHub/GitLab blueprint data and Tier 4 commit-detail data. Cost is deduplicated per conversation.

targets.rawSql: WITH conv_cost AS (SELECT conversation_id, SUM(charged_cents) AS cost_cents FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events WHERE ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY conversation_id), pr_lines AS (SELECT pr.pull_request_key, pr.status, COALESCE(r.name, c.repo_name) AS repo_name, pr.title, pr.url, COUNT(DISTINCT c.commit_hash) AS commit_count, SUM(c.total_lines_added) AS line_count, ROUND(CAST(SUM(c.tab_lines_added + c.composer_lines_added) * 100.0 AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(c.total_lines_added), 0), 0), 1) AS ai_share_pct FROM _tool_cursor_ai_code_commits AS c JOIN (SELECT prc.commit_sha, prc.pull_request_id FROM pull_request_commits AS prc UNION SELECT pr.merge_commit_sha, pr.id FROM pull_requests AS pr WHERE NOT pr.merge_commit_sha IS NULL AND pr.merge_commit_sha <> '') AS pr_map ON pr_map.commit_sha = c.commit_hash JOIN pull_requests AS pr ON pr.id = pr_map.pull_request_id LEFT JOIN repos AS r ON r.id = pr.base_repo_id WHERE $__timeFilter(COALESCE(c.commit_ts, c.ingested_at, c.created_at)) AND ('${connection_id}' = '' OR c.connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND c.scope_id = '${scope_id}' GROUP BY COALESCE(r.name, c.repo_name), pr.pull_request_key, pr.title, pr.url, pr.status), pr_cost AS (SELECT pc.pull_request_key, pc.status, pc.repo_name, pc.title, pc.url, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.conversation_id) AS conversations, SUM(cc.cost_cents) AS cost_cents FROM (SELECT DISTINCT pr.pull_request_key, pr.title, pr.status, COALESCE(r.name, c.repo_name) AS repo_name, pr.url, rann.conversation_id FROM _tool_cursor_ai_code_range_annotations AS rann JOIN _tool_cursor_ai_code_commits AS c ON c.commit_hash = rann.commit_hash AND c.connection_id = rann.connection_id AND c.scope_id = rann.scope_id JOIN (SELECT prc.commit_sha, prc.pull_request_id FROM pull_request_commits AS prc UNION SELECT pr.merge_commit_sha, pr.id FROM pull_requests AS pr WHERE NOT pr.merge_commit_sha IS NULL AND pr.merge_commit_sha <> '') AS pr_map ON pr_map.commit_sha = rann.commit_hash JOIN pull_requests AS pr ON pr.id = pr_map.pull_request_id LEFT JOIN repos AS r ON r.id = pr.base_repo_id WHERE ('${connection_id}' = '' OR rann.connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND rann.scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND rann.conversation_id <> '') AS pc JOIN conv_cost AS cc ON cc.conversation_id = pc.conversation_id GROUP BY pc.pull_request_key, pc.status, pc.repo_name, pc.title, pc.url) SELECT COALESCE(pl.pull_request_key, pc.pull_request_key) AS "PR #", COALESCE(pl.status, pc.status) AS "Status", COALESCE(pl.repo_name, pc.repo_name) AS "Repo", COALESCE(pl.title, pc.title) AS "Title", COALESCE(pl.url, pc.url) AS "URL", COALESCE(pl.commit_count, 0) AS "Commits", COALESCE(pl.line_count, 0) AS "Lines", pl.ai_share_pct AS "AI Share %", COALESCE(pc.conversations, 0) AS "Conversations", ROUND(CAST(CAST(COALESCE(pc.cost_cents, 0) AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(100, 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS "AI Cost (USD)" FROM pr_lines AS pl LEFT JOIN pr_cost AS pc ON pc.pull_request_key = pl.pull_request_key AND pc.repo_name = pl.repo_name AND pc.title = pl.title AND pc.url = pl.url AND pc.status = pl.status WHERE COALESCE(pl.line_count, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(pc.cost_cents, 0) > 0 UNION SELECT pc.pull_request_key, pc.status, pc.repo_name, pc.title, pc.url, 0, 0, "NULL", pc.conversations, ROUND(CAST(CAST(pc.cost_cents AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(100, 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) FROM pr_cost AS pc LEFT JOIN pr_lines AS pl ON pc.pull_request_key = pl.pull_request_key AND pc.repo_name = pl.repo_name AND pc.title = pl.title AND pc.url = pl.url AND pc.status = pl.status WHERE pl.pull_request_key IS NULL ORDER BY "AI Cost (USD)" DESC NULLS LAST, "Lines" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20

panels.title: PR AI Lines & Cost

panels.description: Work category mix for the selected dashboard period (stacked share of conversation counts).

targets.rawSql: WITH totals AS (SELECT dimension_value AS "Category", SUM(count) AS cnt FROM _tool_cursor_conversation_insights WHERE ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND insight_type = 'categories' AND aggregation_type = 'timeSeries' AND $__timeFilter(metric_date) GROUP BY dimension_value) SELECT "Category", ROUND(CAST(cnt * 100.0 AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(cnt) OVER (), 0), 0), 1) AS "Share %" FROM totals ORDER BY cnt DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Work Categories

panels.description: Work type mix for the selected dashboard period. KTLO = Keep The Lights On (maintenance, tech debt, dependency updates).

targets.rawSql: WITH totals AS (SELECT CASE LOWER(dimension_value) WHEN 'ktlo' THEN 'Maintenance (KTLO)' WHEN 'maintenance' THEN 'Maintenance (KTLO)' WHEN 'new_feature' THEN 'New Features' WHEN 'bug' THEN 'Bug Fixing' WHEN 'bug_fix' THEN 'Bug Fixing' ELSE dimension_value END AS "Work Type", SUM(count) AS cnt FROM _tool_cursor_conversation_insights WHERE ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND insight_type = 'workTypes' AND aggregation_type = 'timeSeries' AND $__timeFilter(metric_date) GROUP BY 1) SELECT "Work Type", ROUND(CAST(cnt * 100.0 AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(cnt) OVER (), 0), 0), 1) AS "Share %" FROM totals ORDER BY cnt DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Work Types

panels.description: Conversation intent mix for the selected dashboard period (stacked share of conversation counts).

targets.rawSql: WITH totals AS (SELECT dimension_value AS "Intent", SUM(count) AS cnt FROM _tool_cursor_conversation_insights WHERE ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND insight_type = 'intents' AND aggregation_type = 'timeSeries' AND $__timeFilter(metric_date) GROUP BY dimension_value) SELECT "Intent", ROUND(CAST(cnt * 100.0 AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(cnt) OVER (), 0), 0), 1) AS "Share %" FROM totals ORDER BY cnt DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Conversation Intents

panels.description: Task complexity mix for the selected dashboard period (stacked share of conversation counts).

targets.rawSql: WITH totals AS (SELECT CASE LOWER(dimension_value) WHEN 'low' THEN 'Low' WHEN 'medium' THEN 'Medium' WHEN 'high' THEN 'High' WHEN 'trivial' THEN 'Trivial' ELSE dimension_value END AS "Complexity", SUM(count) AS cnt FROM _tool_cursor_conversation_insights WHERE ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND insight_type = 'complexity' AND aggregation_type = 'timeSeries' AND $__timeFilter(metric_date) GROUP BY 1) SELECT "Complexity", ROUND(CAST(cnt * 100.0 AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(cnt) OVER (), 0), 0), 1) AS "Share %" FROM totals ORDER BY CASE Complexity WHEN 'Trivial' THEN 1 WHEN 'Low' THEN 2 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 3 WHEN 'High' THEN 4 END NULLS FIRST, cnt DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Task Complexity

panels.description: Row counts and latest timestamps for enterprise Cursor tool tables

targets.rawSql: SELECT '_tool_cursor_ai_code_commits' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS row_count, MAX(COALESCE(commit_ts, ingested_at, created_at)) AS latest FROM _tool_cursor_ai_code_commits WHERE ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' UNION ALL SELECT '_tool_cursor_ai_code_changes', COUNT(*), MAX(COALESCE(ingested_at, created_at)) FROM _tool_cursor_ai_code_changes WHERE ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' UNION ALL SELECT '_tool_cursor_ai_code_range_annotations', COUNT(*), MAX(COALESCE(ingested_at, created_at)) FROM _tool_cursor_ai_code_range_annotations WHERE ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' UNION ALL SELECT '_tool_cursor_ai_code_conversations', COUNT(*), MAX(COALESCE(ingested_at, created_at)) FROM _tool_cursor_ai_code_conversations WHERE ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' UNION ALL SELECT '_tool_cursor_conversation_insights', COUNT(*), MAX(COALESCE(metric_date, period_end)) FROM _tool_cursor_conversation_insights WHERE ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
